description: This file defines FastAPI routes for accessing Fama-French financial research data, including factors, portfolio returns, and index returns. It contains multiple API endpoint functions decorated with router.command, each returning financial datasets based on parameters.

methods.name: OBBject factors( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches Fama-French factors data, possibly for different regions or regions with different parameters.

methods.name: list factor_choices( region: Annotated[ Optional[str], FastAPIQuery(description="Region to get factor choices for."), ] = None, factor: Annotated[ Optional[str], FastAPIQuery( description="Factor to get interval choices for.", ), ] = None, is_portfolio: Annotated[ Optional[bool], FastAPIQuery( description="When True, returns portfolio choices by region.", ), ] = None, portfolio: Annotated[ Optional[str], FastAPIQuery( description="When supplied, returns regional choices for the portfolio.", ), ] = None, )
methods.description: Provides dynamic menu choices for widget development, importing helper functions.

methods.name: OBBject us_portfolio_returns( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves US portfolio returns data for constructing Fama-French Factor models.

methods.name: OBBject regional_portfolio_returns( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves regional portfolio returns for constructing Fama-French models.

methods.name: OBBject country_portfolio_returns( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves country-specific portfolio returns for Fama-French models.

methods.name: OBBject international_index_returns( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Provides benchmark index returns for international Fama-French models.

methods.name: OBBject breakpoints( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Provides subject-specific breakpoints for constructing research portfolios.
